Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting signature gathering by sex offenders.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to signature gathering by sex offenders; and addinga new section to chapter 29A.72 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.72 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person with a duty to register as a sex offender under RCW9A.44.130 is prohibited from gathering signatures for any initiative orreferendum measure. (2) Petitions circulated by a person with a duty to register as asex offender under RCW 9A.44.130 shall not be counted when determiningwhether the initiative measure contains sufficient signatures. (3) A valid signatory may recover statutory damages of two hundreddollars and actual damages from the entity or person employing a sexoffender with a duty to register under RCW 9A.44.130 as a paid orvolunteer signature gatherer. For the purposes of this section, avalid signatory is a person whose signature on a petition would countbut for the fact that the petition was circulated by a person with aduty to register as a sex offender under RCW 9A.44.130. In an action p. 1 SB 6159to recover statutory or actual damages under this section, theprevailing party is entitled to reasonable attorneys' fees and costs.
